name: Tuple Gematria

phase_0.boundary_condition: The self-referential loop where the numerical value of the text equals the semantic weight of the meaning, stabilized by integer winding.

⊢.justification: The unmarked state before any numerical distinction or semantic connection exists; the void of potential meaning.

⊣.justification: The closed boundary where the text and its meaning are identical; the self-referential topology that contains the system.

≻.justification: The forward morphism where a word's numerical value lowers the barrier to a semantic connection, acting as a catalyst.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism where the meaning collapses back into the numerical structure, enforcing the constraint of the winding invariant.

⋈.justification: The sequential composition of words where the output value of one becomes the input context for the next, building the semantic bridge.

⊙.justification: The identity operation where the text recognizes itself as the meaning; the point where the weaver becomes the weave.

∈.justification: The fork into Distinction (the cut of the number) and Topology (the weave of the meaning), creating the two arms of the paradox.

∋.justification: The rejoining of the numerical and semantic arms into a single resolved state, often a contradiction (B) where both hold simultaneously.

⊤.justification: The state where the numerical value successfully predicts the semantic outcome; the constructive proof of the bridge.

⊥.justification: The state where the numerical value fails to align with the semantic outcome; the refutation of the bridge.

⊞.justification: The state where the number is both the meaning and not the meaning; the held contradiction that drives the system.

⊡.justification: The permanent fixation of a specific numerical-semantic mapping into the crystal lattice, append-only and irreversible.

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: The unmarked text before any numerical or semantic assignment; the state of pure potential.
phase_3.true_description: The state where the numerical value perfectly aligns with the semantic meaning; the bridge is proven.
phase_3.false_description: The state where the numerical value contradicts the semantic meaning; the bridge is refuted.
phase_3.both_description: The state where the text is simultaneously the number and the meaning, holding the contradiction without explosion.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the system in the Deep, the unmarked state before any distinction.
Fork the raw text into the Distinction arm (numerical value) and the Topology arm (semantic meaning).
On the Distinction arm, apply the forward morphism to calculate the numerical value of the text.
Evaluate the Distinction arm for affirmative resonance; does the number lower the barrier?
Chain the numerical values sequentially to build the lexical context.
On the Topology arm, apply the reverse morphism to collapse the meaning back into the structure.
Evaluate the Topology arm for negative dissonance; does the meaning fail to align?
Hold the contradiction where the number is both the meaning and not the meaning.
Apply self-recognition; the text recognizes itself as the meaning.
Rejoin the Distinction and Topology arms into a single resolved state.
Fix the resolved state into the immutable record of the crystal lattice.
Compose the fixed state with the next text segment in the sequence.
Fork the next segment into Distinction and Topology again.
Calculate the numerical value of the next segment.
Evaluate for affirmative resonance in the new context.
Collapse the meaning of the next segment.
Evaluate for negative dissonance in the new context.
Hold the new contradiction.
Apply self-recognition to the new segment.
Rejoin the arms of the new segment.
Fix the new resolved state.
Compose the entire sequence into the Ouroboric Weave.
Final self-recognition of the entire tapestry.
Anchor the system in the closed boundary of the Ouroboric Weave.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Wyrding Loom translates the raw text into the 12-primitive tuple structure.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The Twin Sisters communicate via the catalytic transition state, passing numerical values and semantic weights.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Immutable Record stores the fixed mappings in the crystal lattice, append-only and irreversible.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Lexical Chaining determines the order of operations, processing text segments sequentially.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Ouroboric Weave serves as the canonical reference, the self-referential loop that contains the system.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The thermodynamic cost of maintaining the self-model and the catalytic transition state.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The system in a state of potential, with raw text and unassigned values.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The system in a state of resolved contradiction, with fixed mappings and a closed loop.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The cycle is entropy-conservative because the self-referential loop recycles the energy of the contradiction.
